facts.fact: The Personal Data Protection Commission ruled in Abdul Said Naumanga v. Mi Casa Company Limited, ex parte, awarding TZS 20,000,000 and ordering deletion of the complainant's personal data; the decision date is not given, so the document's published date of 2025-08-03 is used.

The Personal Data Protection Commission hears complaints and enforces the Personal Data Protection Act, Cap 44, which the document says is in effect from 1 May 2023; the document's published date of 2025-08-03 is used for the Commission's operation.
